extracted.name: Roasted Sweet Potatoes and Onions
extracted.description: This roasted sweet potato side dish with onions, thyme, and toasted sliced almonds is delicious and nutritious.
ingredient_lines: 2 large sweet potatoes, peeled and cut in 1-inch chunks
2 medium Vidalia or other sweet onions, cut in 1-inch chunks
Salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C).
Toss sweet potatoes, onions, olive oil, amaretto, thyme, salt and pepper in a shallow medium-sized baking dish.
Cover and bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake 20 minutes more. Sprinkle with toasted almonds.
